text:
margo: Quick sync — observed 47 leads move to 'never-owned' in the last 2h after enrichment failures. Could be HubSpot webhook timing + SF mapping race. @teo can you pull HS activity?

teo: on it, pulling the workflow logs now. suspecting enrichment TTL expired before round-robin assigned owner.

samir: what's the enrichment TTL currently? I thought it was 8h.

lucy: hs property `enrich_status` shows `pending` -> `failed` for many; vendor returned 429s around 09:14 PT.

margo: timeline: inbound lead created -> enrichment call -> wait for token -> round-robin trigger -> owner assignment. If enrichment slow, RR sometimes hits empty pool and marks never-owned.

jen: can we debounce the RR trigger until `enrich_status` is `complete` or after 30m? quick patch: delay RR by 15m for leads with enrichment_pending true.

teo: hacky rule I'd run in HS: `if enrich_status != 'complete' and age < 30m then skip RR`. Example filter: 
```
lead.status == 'new' && lead.enrich_status != 'complete' && lead.age_minutes < 30
```

samir: also adding fallback: if RR fails, enqueue to 'rr-manual-retry' queue + webhook to SF owner sync.

lucy: vendor responded with rate-limit window; ops throttled requests. I've requested a soft increase and added client-side exponential backoff.

margo: ok plan: (1) add 30m debounce rule in HS (2) add RR retry queue + alert on >10 failed assignments/hr (3) vendor backoff + monitoring. @sales-bot will escalate leads older than 2h without owner.

sales-bot: [automated] Leads >2h without owner: send daily digest to #sales-ops.

jen: I'll open a quick PR for the HS workflow change and a playbook entry for triage.

teo: linking traces: https://redwood.internal/trace/xyz123 - shows enrichment latency spike around 09:14.

margo: thanks team. Can we ship the debounce today + monitor overnight? :eyes:

samir: yes — will push the HS rule and add alerting. planning to revert to 15m if vendor SLA improves.

lucy: will follow up with vendor and share ETA.

margo: sweet. I'll update the inbound playbook. Thanks :thumbsup:
